title: 第294章 修真小队第293章 家里人
content_zh:
在家里待了不到一个星期，王建新就坐不住了。
青海那边的基地，他从突破之前就没再去过，算下来好几个月了。第一批那一百个人练到什么程度了？工程收尾了没有？这些事老首长虽然在盯着，但具体的情况还得他自己去看。
他跟小梅说了一声，带上警卫班，坐上专机，直奔青海。
飞机上，王建新靠在椅背上闭目养神，脑子里盘算着基地的事。第一批他走之前已经有一部分引灵入体了，个把月就能突破练气一层。现在过去好几个月了，应该都突破了。要是有人练得快的，说不定都到二层了。
专机降落在西宁军用机场。兰州军区派了参谋长来接，接着一行人一路往青海湖开。路还是那条路，坑坑洼洼的，但比上次来的时候好走了一些，估计是部队修过。
开了将近三个小时，到了基地外围。
远远地就看见了一道铁丝网，两米多高，顶端拉着刺绳，每隔几十米就有一个岗亭。铁丝网外面立着一块牌子，白底红字，写着“军事禁区，严禁入内”。牌子下面是一个检查站，两个武警战士端着枪站在那儿，看见王建新的车，敬了个礼，检查了证件，才放行。
过了检查站，往里又开了十几分钟，才到了基地的核心区域。
王建新下了车，站在那儿看了一圈，心里头挺满意。
基地比上次来的时候气派多了。地面上的营房已经全部建好，青砖灰瓦，一排排整整齐齐。营房前面是一个大操场，铺了水泥，能跑操、能训练。操场边上立着一根旗杆，五星红旗在风里飘扬。食堂、仓库、医务室、会议室，该有的都有。
地下工程更是下了功夫。入口在营房后面的一栋不起眼的平房里，门口有武警站岗。进去之后是一条长长的斜坡通道，两侧全是钢筋混凝土浇筑的墙，又厚又结实。走到底，就是地下三层的主体建筑。
王建新先去了一楼。地下一层是队员宿舍，一间一间的小房间，每个房间住两个人。床、书桌、衣柜，全是新的。走廊上有卫生间、淋浴间、开水房，条件虽然谈不上多好，但比一般的军营强多了。
地下二层是仓库和设备层。存放着训练器材、武器弹药、通讯设备，还有一些生活物资。王建新看了一眼，东西备得挺全，说明后勤保障没掉链子。
地下三层是核心——修炼密室。密室在楼的最深处，四面全是厚厚的混凝土墙，门是一道钢制的防爆门，关上去严丝合缝。王建新推门进去，密室里头很宽敞，足有好几百平米，挑高也将近四米，站里头一点也不觉得憋屈。
密室的四角各放了一个灵气检测仪，虽然这玩意儿测不出太精确的数据，但能看出个大概。王建新扫了一眼，数据比他上次来的时候高了不少。他闭上眼睛感应了一下，灵脉就在密室正下方，灵气透过岩石层渗透上来，浓度虽然比不上他空间里的，但比外面强了不知道多少倍。
从密室出来，王建新问了基地的负责人：“队员们呢？”
“报告首长，一大队正在训练场搞体能训练，二大队在会议室上理论课。”负责人是个四十来岁的团长，姓刘，以前是工程兵部队的，搞基建是一把好手，被调过来当了基地的行政主管。
“走，去训练场看看。”
训练场在营房的东边，一大片空地，铺着沙子和细石子。王建新到的时候，第一队的十个人正在跑步。不是普通的跑步，是负重跑。每个人背着几百斤的沙袋，在操场上绕圈，一个个跑得汗流浃背。
王建新站在边上，看着他们跑，几个月不见，他们的精气神明显不一样了。以前看着就是普通的特种兵，身体素质好、意志力强，但没什么特别的。现在再看，他们的眼神变了，变得更深沉、更锐利，整个人透着一股沉稳劲儿。

这说明什么？说明引灵入体对他们的改变，不只是身体上的，还有精神上的。灵气入体之后，会慢慢改造一个人的体质和神魂，让他们的感知更敏锐、反应更快、心态更稳。
带队的队长叫韩卫国，原来是兰州军区某特种大队的副大队长，三十出头，个头不高，但浑身上下全是腱子肉。看见王建新来了，他喊了一声“集合”，五十个人立刻停下来，跑步到他面前站成一纵队，动作利索得像机器一样。
“报告局长，天枢局青海训练基地第一大队正在训练，请指示！”
王建新摆了摆手：“继续训练，结束后你到我办公室来。”
“是！”
回到办公室，他拿出档案翻了一遍。第一大队五十个人的情况都在上面，每个人的修炼进度、身体状况、心理评估，写得清清楚楚。
韩卫国，练气一层巅峰，随时可能突破到二层。赵铁军，练气一层中期。孙大壮，练气一层中期。剩下的都是练气一层初期。进度最快的是韩卫国，这跟王建新估计的差不多。这个人底子最好，意志也最坚定，修炼起来比别人快一截是很正常的事。
王建新把档案合上，等着韩卫国到来。
不到半个钟头，韩卫国换了一身干净的作训服，跑了过来。
“坐下吧。”王建新指了指旁边的长椅。
韩卫国坐下来，腰板挺得笔直，双手放在膝盖上。
王建新目光落在韩卫国身上。
“卫国，你跟我说说，修炼到现在，有什么感受？”
韩卫国想了想，说：“局长，最大的感受是身体的变化。以前在特种大队的时候，我就觉得自己够强了。但修炼之后才发现，以前那点本事不算什么。现在我的力量、速度、反应，都比以前强了好几倍。而且夜里的视力特别好，黑咕隆咚的也能看得很清楚。还有就是直觉，有时候不用眼睛看，就能感觉到周围有没有人、有没有危险。”
content_en:
After staying at home for less than a week, Wang Jianxin couldn't sit still.
He had not been to the base in Qinghai since before the breakthrough. It had been several months. How far have the first batch of 100 people practiced? Is the project finished? Although the old chief is keeping an eye on these things, he still has to see the specific situation himself.
He told Xiaomei, took the security team with him, got on a special plane, and headed straight to Qinghai.
On the plane, Wang Jianxin leaned back in his chair and closed his eyes to rest, thinking about the base. The first batch of people had already introduced some of their spirits into their bodies before they left, and they were able to break through to the first level of Qi training within a few months. It has been several months now, and I should have broken through. If someone practices quickly, they might reach the second floor.
The special plane landed at Xining Military Airport. The Lanzhou Military Region sent the chief of staff to pick him up, and then the group drove all the way to Qinghai Lake. The road is still the same, full of potholes, but it is easier to walk than the last time we came here. It must have been repaired by the army.
After driving for nearly three hours, we arrived at the outskirts of the base.
From a distance, I saw a barbed wire fence, more than two meters high, with a barbed wire on the top, and a guard box every few dozen meters. There was a sign outside the barbed wire fence with red letters on a white background that read "Military restricted area, no entry allowed." Below the sign was a checkpoint. Two armed police soldiers stood there with guns in hand. When they saw Wang Jianxin's car, they saluted and checked their documents before letting them go.
After passing the checkpoint, we drove in for another ten minutes before we reached the core area of ​​the base.
Wang Jianxin got out of the car and stood there looking around, feeling quite satisfied.
The base is much more impressive than the last time I came here. All the barracks on the ground have been built, with green bricks and gray tiles, neatly arranged in rows. In front of the barracks is a large playground, which is paved with cement and can be used for running and training. There is a flagpole standing on the edge of the playground, and the five-star red flag is fluttering in the wind. Canteen, warehouse, infirmary, conference room, everything you need is there.
Even more effort has been put into the underground engineering. The entrance is in an inconspicuous bungalow behind the barracks, with armed police standing guard at the door. After entering, there is a long slope passage with reinforced concrete walls on both sides, which are thick and strong. At the end, you will find the main building with three underground floors.
Wang Jianxin went to the first floor first. The basement floor is the team dormitory, a small room with two people in each room. The bed, desk, and wardrobe are all new. There are toilets, showers, and boiling water rooms in the corridor. Although the conditions are not very good, they are much better than ordinary military camps.
The second underground floor is the warehouse and equipment floor. Training equipment, weapons and ammunition, communication equipment, and some daily necessities are stored. Wang Jianxin took a look and saw that everything was fully prepared, indicating that the logistics support was intact.
The three underground floors are the core - the secret training room. The secret room is in the deepest part of the building, surrounded by thick concrete walls. The door is a steel blast-proof door that closes tightly. Wang Jianxin pushed the door open and went in. The secret room was very spacious, covering several hundred square meters, and the height was nearly four meters. Standing there did not feel uncomfortable at all.
There is an aura detector placed at each corner of the secret room. Although this device cannot measure very precise data, it can give a general idea. Wang Jianxin glanced at it and saw that the data was much higher than the last time he came. He closed his eyes and sensed it. The spiritual veins were right below the secret room. The spiritual energy seeped up through the rock layer. Although the concentration was not as high as in his space, it was many times stronger than outside.
Coming out of the secret room, Wang Jianxin asked the person in charge of the base: "Where are the team members?"
"Report to the leader, the first team is doing physical training at the training ground, and the second team is having theoretical classes in the conference room." The person in charge is a forty-year-old regiment leader, surnamed Liu, who used to be in the engineering corps. He is good at infrastructure construction and was transferred here to become the administrative director of the base.
"Let's go to the training ground."
The training ground is to the east of the barracks, a large open space paved with sand and fine pebbles. kingWhen Jianxin arrived, the ten people in the first team were running. It's not an ordinary run, it's a weight-bearing run. Each person carried hundreds of kilograms of sandbags and circled the playground, sweating profusely.
Wang Jianxin stood on the side and watched them run. After not seeing each other for several months, their spirits were obviously different. In the past, they looked like ordinary special forces soldiers, with good physical fitness and strong willpower, but nothing special. Looking back now, their eyes have changed, becoming deeper and sharper, and their whole person has a calm energy.
What does this mean? Explain that the changes brought about by bringing spirits into their bodies are not only physical, but also mental. After the spiritual energy enters the body, it will slowly transform a person's physique and soul, making their perception sharper, their reactions faster, and their mentality more stable.
The leader of the team was named Han Weiguo, who turned out to be the deputy captain of a special brigade in the Lanzhou Military Region. He was in his early thirties, not tall, but his body was covered with tendons. Seeing Wang Jianxin coming, he shouted "assemble", and fifty people immediately stopped, ran to him and stood in a column, moving as neatly as machines.
"Reporting to the director, the first brigade of Qinghai Training Base of Tianshu Bureau is training, please give instructions!"
Wang Jianxin waved his hand: "Continue training, and come to my office after it's over."
"Yes!"
Back in the office, he took out the file and looked through it. The conditions of the fifty people in the first brigade are all listed above. Each person's cultivation progress, physical condition, and psychological evaluation are clearly written.
Han Weiguo, who is at the peak of the first level of Qi training, may break through to the second level at any time. Zhao Tiejun is in the middle of the first level of Qi training. Sun Dazhuang is in the middle of the first level of Qi training. The rest are all in the early stages of Qi training. The fastest progress is made by Han Weiguo, which is similar to what Wang Jianxin expected. This person has the best foundation and the strongest will. It is normal for him to practice faster than others.
Wang Jianxin closed the file and waited for Han Weiguo to arrive.
In less than half an hour, Han Weiguo changed into clean training clothes and ran over.
"Sit down." Wang Jianxin pointed to the bench next to him.
Han Weiguo sat down with his back straight and his hands on his knees.
Wang Jianxin's eyes fell on Han Weiguo.
"Weiguo, tell me, how do you feel after practicing till now?"
Han Weiguo thought for a while and said, "Director, the biggest feeling is the change in my body. When I was in the special brigade, I felt that I was strong enough. But after practicing, I realized that my previous abilities were nothing. Now my strength, speed, and reaction are several times stronger than before. And my eyesight at night is particularly good, and I can see clearly even in the dark. There is also intuition. Sometimes I can feel whether there is anyone around me or whether there is danger without using my eyes."
